en.headline: Government launches new silver bonds with 4.25% guaranteed rate
en.dek: The 11th batch targets HK$50 billion and may rise to HK$55 billion; applications open 21 August for residents born in or before 1967, with issuance on 15 September.
body: The Government announced details of the latest Silver Bond issuance on Thursday, offering a guaranteed minimum interest rate of 4.25 per cent, higher than the 3.85 per cent of the previous batch.

The three-year bonds form the 11th series under the programme. The target size is HK$50 billion, with the option to increase it to HK$55 billion depending on demand. Each unit costs HK$10,000 and the maximum allocation per investor is 100 units, or HK$1 million. Interest is paid semi-annually at the higher of the fixed floor or a floating rate linked to local inflation.

Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the rate was set after considering market conditions, comparable products and prevailing interest rates. Eligible applicants are Hong Kong residents born in or before 1967 who hold a valid Hong Kong identity card. Subscription runs from 9am on 21 August to 2pm on 4 September through placing banks and designated securities brokers. The bonds will be issued on 15 September.

Proceeds will go into the Capital Works Reserve Fund to finance or refinance infrastructure projects. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority will arrange the issue, with Bank of China (Hong Kong) and HSBC as joint arrangers.

zh.headline: 新一批銀色債券保證息率4.25厘 最高發行額550億
zh.dek: 第11批銀債目標發行額500億元，可視乎認購反應上調至550億元；1967年或之前出生居民可於8月21日起認購，9月15日發行。
body: 政府周四公布最新一批銀色債券詳情，保證最低息率為4.25厘，高於上批的3.85厘。
債券為三年期，屬計劃下第11批。目標發行額500億元，可按認購情況最多加碼至550億元。每手1萬元，每名投資者最高獲配100手，即100萬元。利息每半年派發一次，以固定下限或與本地通脹掛鈎的浮息兩者較高者計算。
財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇表示，息率經參考市況、類似產品價格及利率後釐定。合資格人士為1967年或之前出生並持有效香港身份證的居民。認購期由8月21日上午9時至9月4日下午2時，可透過配售銀行或指定證券經紀申請，債券將於9月15日發行。
所得資金撥入基本工程儲備基金，為基建項目融資或再融資。金管局負責安排，中銀香港及滙豐為聯席安排行。
